name: ecochatbot-ma
description: EcoChatBot-MA — Sistema de Atendimento Digital Configurável (Monorepo)

scripts.start: concurrently -n BACKEND,FRONTEND -c blue,green "npm run start:backend" "npm run start:frontend"
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd frontend && npm install && cd ../backend && npm install
scripts.test: echo "Use: cd frontend && npm test  ou  cd backend && npm test" && exit 1

author: Aldemir Queiroz
